title: mgxrl: Source-level trust weighting for resilient consensus secondary control of microgrids (code, reference model, trained policies and results)
description: Code, MATLAB reference model, trained policies and result tables for the manuscript 'Source-Level Trust Weighting for Resilient Consensus Secondary Control of Islanded Microgrids on Sparse Communication Graphs' (submitted for Publication). Version 1.1.0 adds: the calibrated innovation-threshold rule, receiver-side W-MSR and oracle-isolation comparators evaluated on the same paired seeds as the learned PPO policies (scripts/23); robustness and transfer tests covering communication delay, packet loss and quantization, a threshold-aware adversary, isolation latency, denser circulant graphs, rings of 6 and 14 units, and a radial feeder with a chain communication graph (scripts/24); an independent MATLAB reference with inner voltage loops that replays 60 exported scenarios (scripts/25-26, matlab/validate_threshold_rule.m); a paired trajectory example (scripts/27); and figure scripts for the revised manuscript. Retained from 1.0.0: the reduced-order ten-DG islanded microgrid plant and six consensus-signal attack injectors; the Gymnasium environment with per-source trust-weight actions and safety projection; PPO training and paired-seed evaluation; the pre-training admissibility tests; the mechanism sweeps behind the consensus-bias scaling law; forensic scripts for the public IEEE DataPort release; explanation and detector-benchmark code from the earlier version; and the final policies with VecNormalize statistics. reproduce_all.ps1 runs the full chain in dependency order. The IEEE DataPort release is not redistributed; the synthetic corpus is archived separately (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24082859). Code under Apache-2.0; result tables and figures under CC BY 4.0.
